title: Describe native access scope
responsibility: Explain the project access requested by a native device before approval.

inputs.name: nativeScope.resource
inputs.description: projects for all current/future shared projects, project: followed by an ID for one project, or null/other text.

inputs.name: nativeScope.projects
inputs.description: Project lookup used only for a nonempty single-project ID.

outputs.name: nativeScope
outputs.description: Readable scope wording: all projects, the fetched project name only, or an unavailable-project message when lookup fails. Missing or unrecognized scope is described conservatively as all projects with an ambiguity note.
